notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39869314/a111044630c5466b3001c61ae714e650a612152e.png

Image text:
After years of scattered progress, recent developments have given the three of us the opportunity to work on Compound Fracture full-time.
We're going to be putting our nose to the grindstone, so expect less frequent updates but know that behind the scenes we will be working harder than we've ever dreamed possible.

We are immensely grateful for your support that has brought us here so please keep an eye out on Steam and Twitter for future updates.

- Austin, Cyrus, and Pete
